description: Change the sale price of one Coupang item (option), in KRW. 옵션(아이템) 판매가를 변경합니다. Coupang rejects changes beyond its allowed ratio from the current price unless forceSalePriceUpdate is true. Needs vendorItemId and the new price.

confirm_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: the tool then only returns a preview and a token. Show the preview to the user, and only after they agree call again with exactly the same arguments plus this token. 처음엔 비워 두세요. 미리보기를 사용자에게 보여주고 동의를 받은 뒤, 같은 인자에 이 토큰을 넣어 다시 호출합니다.

forceSalePriceUpdate.description: Allow a change larger than Coupang's default guard ratio

price.description: New sale price in KRW (multiple of 10)

name: coupang_update_item_price
